summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.83/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.83 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 19, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 2¢ higher than a week ago, 12¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.07 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.61) and the highest in Superior ($4.15).
